headline: WNBA Semifinals Eve: Final Four tactical breakdown as Lynx-Fever and Aces-Liberty prepare for Game 1
whyCareReason: Historic first-round sweeps set up the most star-studded semifinals in league history: Caitlin Clark challenges Minnesota's fortress while the Aces and Liberty renew their heavyweight war.
teaser: Saturday practice reports: Fever prepare for Target Center hostile crowd, while Sabrina Ionescu and Breanna Stewart brace for A'ja Wilson's surging Aces on Sunday.
story:
Why this one matters: Saturday brings the calm before the storm in the WNBA as the four surviving heavyweights complete final walkthroughs ahead of Sunday's Game 1 doubleheader.

In Minneapolis, Cheryl Reeve and the top-seeded Lynx face the ultimate transition test against Caitlin Clark and the Indiana Fever. Minnesota's league-leading defense, anchored by Defensive Player of the Year Napheesa Collier, will attempt to trap Clark at the logo and force secondary playmakers like Kelsey Mitchell and Aliyah Boston to create.

Meanwhile in New York, the Liberty host the two-time champion Las Vegas Aces in a rematch of the 2023 Finals. Becky Hammon's Aces have found their championship stride behind unanimous MVP A'ja Wilson, while Sandy Brondello's Liberty counter with Breanna Stewart and the electric perimeter shooting of Sabrina Ionescu. A spot in the 2026 Finals awaits the victors in two best-of-five wars.
stakes: Game 1 momentum in two best-of-five series that will crown the 2026 WNBA finalists.
rivalryAngle: Clark's rapid ascent faces Minnesota's tactical discipline, while Aces vs Liberty defines this era of women's basketball.
